## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah; Altmann, Manfred Altmann [27. Juli 1940], SZ-AAL/B1.36
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.36
- Datum: 27.7.1940
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Hotel Central (next adress will come by cable) 27. II 1940
Dear Hannah and Manfred, as you see we are preparing already our
next voyage and we have not yet quite decided, how to do it, by boat
or by plane. All is complicated as I have to visit the cities in the
North of Brazil, Bahia, Olinda, Pernambuco, the isle of Marajo —
it will be no pure pleasure to visit equatorial countries just in the
sammer time but we are „Kämmer quäler“ we know already what
a Brazilian summer has in store and support it quite well. The advantage
is that by this half the travel will cost nothing — the other half from
the frontier to the States is still expensive enough. Great difficulties means
the costume. On the plane we can have not much luggage, in North Brazil
it will have 40 degrees over zero and in Newyork 20 degrees under zero three
days later. But Lotte stands all this through much better than I thought and
we work every day, eating very little during the heat and sleeping much. All
the trouble of Brazilian summer-life could be averted with the expense of
a air conditioned room, an „anticearhaltring“? — then one could live even
in summer-time here and we love even now this wonderful city very much.
Now about you. Please have after a weeks rest in Bath, do spend freely
and do not worry, be sure that we shall look after Eva and give you more
news about her. You can thoroughly rely upon us. I hope Friedental got his
visa, the Argentine Consul makes it a speciality to make difficulties; he
had the telegrafic order for Landschoff and Friedental in the first days of
November and as he did not deliver it (to our astonishment) to Landschoff
who immediately applied, the Foreign Minister cabled a second time to de-
liver touristvisas to both, I cabled you the date of the second cable. Give
my love to Martha, to all friends, tell Flescher, that I had never a reply
on my letter to him and believe me yours sincerely and faithfully Stefan Zweig
Only a few words today as it is time to post the letter.
We are feeling hot but well and Stefan is glad of the good
chance to lose weight. Nevertheless, winter weather will be a
pleasant change, and I am looking forward to it and to seeing
Eva again.
Yours, Lotte.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf rosa Papier. Das Datum '27. II 1940' ist im Original so geschrieben, obwohl der Kontext (Sommer in Brasilien) eher auf Juli hindeutet. 'Kämmer quäler' und 'anticearhaltring' sind vermutlich idiosynkratische Schreibweisen oder Wortschöpfungen.

pages.notes: Gleicher Text wie Seite 1, jedoch mit überlagerten Archiv-Hilfsmitteln (Farbkarte #13 und Grauskala #13).

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, trotz einiger ungewöhnlicher Schreibweisen (z.B. 'anticearhaltring'). Die Archiv-Hilfsmittel auf Seite 3 verdecken den Text teilweise, dieser ist jedoch durch den Vergleich mit Seite 1 vollständig rekonstruierbar.
